needs_you.action: Finish Ozone Ascent Timed Research and claim the Meteorite and Rayquaza rewards by 8pm local
Buy the Glimmers of Gratitude Masterwork Research ($4.99, Shiny Shaymin) before Ultra Unlock ends at 8pm local
Race Zorua's hide-and-sneak courses for the trophy before the event ends at 4:59am local
Finish the July Traveler's Log for the free Bilgewater X-TREME mount and spend or freeze Tender before the Aug 1 rollover
Claim GO Pass: July rewards by 10am local (rank earning ends Aug 4 at 10am)
Bank your fourth Mastery of the Timeways week before Turbulent Timeways ends to secure the Spawn of Vyranoth mount
Farm double-rate Illusionary Coins and buy Decor Duels rewards before patch 12.1 removes the event
Evolve Nickit by 9pm local on Community Day to get Thievul with Icy Wind

games.typical_lead_time: in-game calendar visible 4+ weeks out; shop and patch news 1-2 weeks

timeline.title: Turbulent Timeways V
timeline.detail: Run four Timewalking dungeons per week in four separate weeks before Aug 11 for the Spawn of Vyranoth mount, with Dragonflight Timewalking debuting and a stacking XP buff up to 30%.

timeline.title: Trading Post: True-Blue Celebration
timeline.detail: Finish the Traveler's Log for the free Bilgewater X-TREME mount and spend or freeze Tender on items like the Wailing Banshee's Charger (575) before the month flips Aug 1.

timeline.title: Decor Duels: Final Surge
timeline.detail: Play Decor Duels in Silvermoon City for double Illusionary Coins and buy the Magister's Spell Bee Comb mount (500 coins) before the mode and many rewards are removed in patch 12.1.
timeline.estimate_basis: Removal confirmed at 12.1 launch; 12.1 has no announced date, community projects mid-to-late August

timeline.title: Last chance: Midnight Season 1
timeline.detail: Wrap up Season 1 goals (Keystone Master, elite PvP transmog, Mythic raid rewards) before Season 1 ends when patch 12.1 launches.
timeline.estimate_basis: Season 1 ends at patch 12.1; no announced date, community estimates Aug 11 or Aug 25

timeline.title: Catch the Drift subscription promo
timeline.detail: Buy or hold a 6- or 12-month recurring subscription for the Sunflare Driftmoth mount and Sunflutter Driftmoth pet; existing 6/12-month subscribers get them automatically by Jul 31.

timeline.title: WoW BlizzCon 2026 Bundle
timeline.detail: Buy the bundle (Rabbit'ath Void mount, Garb of the Dawnfire Phoenix ensemble, housing decor) on the Battle.net Shop by Sep 28, limit one per account.

timeline.title: Darkmoon Faire
timeline.detail: Visit Darkmoon Island during the first week of August for tickets, profession quests, and the monthly carousel and top-hat buffs.

timeline.title: Trial of Style
timeline.detail: Queue for the transmog contest scenario to earn Trial of Style tokens for exclusive ensembles.

timeline.title: Trading Post: August rotation
timeline.detail: A new rotation arrives Aug 1 with 500 Tender auto-granted plus up to 500 from the Traveler's Log.
timeline.estimate_basis: Rollover date is fixed; official August item list not yet posted, expected around end of July

timeline.title: Free T-Shirt Day (micro-holiday)
timeline.detail: Visit the seven vendor NPCs across Azeroth during this one-day micro-holiday to collect the seven shirt cosmetics.

timeline.title: Northrend Cup
timeline.detail: Fly 12 Northrend skyriding race courses in Normal, Advanced, and Reverse modes for Riders of Azeroth Badges and cosmetics.

timeline.title: Patch 12.1: Curse of Ula'tek
timeline.detail: The next content update brings a new island zone, a new dungeon, instanced world bosses, and the 8-boss Venomous Abyss raid, with Season 2 starting one week later.
timeline.estimate_basis: On PTR now with no official date; community projects Aug 11 or Aug 25 from the usual 8-week cadence

weekly_rhythm: Week of Jul 21: Classic Timewalking (Turbulent Timeways week 4, Blackrock Depths TW raid); PvP Brawl: Arathi Blizzard
Week of Jul 28: Burning Crusade Timewalking (TT week 5, Black Temple TW raid); Arena Skirmish Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Gravity Lapse
Week of Aug 4: Dragonflight Timewalking (TT final week, ends Aug 11); PvP Brawl: Deepwind Dunk; Darkmoon Faire and Trial of Style run Aug 1-8
Week of Aug 11: World Quest Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Shado-Pan Showdown; Free T-Shirt Day Aug 16
Week of Aug 18: Battleground Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Warsong Scramble
Week of Aug 25: Pet Battle Bonus Event and Northrend Timewalking; PvP Brawl: Cooking Impossible; Northrend Cup begins
just_past_window: Sep 1-8: Delves Bonus Event; PvP Brawl: Temple of Hotmogu
Sep 5-12: Darkmoon Faire (estimated from first-Saturday cadence)
Sep 8-15: PvP Brawl: Southshore vs Tarren Mill

games.typical_lead_time: events usually announced 1-4 weeks ahead; season schedule posted at season start

timeline.title: GO Pass: July
timeline.detail: Earn ranks through Aug 4 at 10am local; Ho-Oh waits at rank 100 and anniversary-coin Gimmighoul at ranks 101 and 200, Deluxe upgrade $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: 10th Anniversary Edition
timeline.detail: Catch Alola, Galar, and Paldea starters with 10x catch XP Jul 25-27, and grab the Glimmers of Gratitude Masterwork Research ($4.99, Shiny Shaymin) before 8pm local Jul 27.

timeline.title: Ozone Ascent
timeline.detail: Grab a free Meteorite and Rayquaza encounter from Timed Research to teach Dragon Ascent; all research expires Jul 26 at 8pm local, optional paid research $4.99.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Fairy Trail
timeline.detail: Pick one locked path (Explore, Catch, or Battle) that shapes your week of Timed Research, then finish it before Aug 3 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Gigantamax Rillaboom Max Battle Day
timeline.detail: Battle Gigantamax Rillaboom in 6-star Max Battles with Shiny G-Max Rillaboom debuting and 8x Max Particles from Power Spots; optional $4.99 research adds a Max Mushroom.

timeline.title: GO Pass: August
timeline.detail: Earn toward Latias encounters (shiny possible) and the Lucky Trinket; Deluxe $7.99 or $9.99 with 10 ranks, ranks close Sep 8 at 10am local, Trinket must be used by Sep 13.

timeline.title: Summer Marathon: Arctic Embers
timeline.detail: Shiny Snom debuts via GO Pass tasks and eggs, with boosted-shiny Ponyta, Slugma, Snover, and Vanillite rotating daily; free Timed Research expires Aug 10 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Fire and Ice Hatch Day
timeline.detail: Hatch Smoochum and Magby from 2km eggs at half hatch distance with boosted shiny odds and 2x hatch Candy; Larvesta possible from 5km eggs.

timeline.title: Choose Your Path: Venom and Vines
timeline.detail: Pick your Explore, Catch, or Battle path again for a week of tailored Timed Research; claim everything before Aug 17 at 8pm local.

timeline.title: Nickit Community Day
timeline.detail: Catch Shiny-boosted Nickit with 3x catch Stardust and evolve it by 9pm local for Thievul with Icy Wind; optional $1.99 Special Research adds Special Background encounters.

timeline.title: Ultra Unlock: Water Festival
timeline.detail: Arrokuda, Barraskewda, and Cramorant debut alongside Shiny Ducklett and Dewpider boosts; catch bonuses climb to 4x XP and 5x Stardust by Aug 22-24, event pass rewards expire Aug 26.

timeline.title: Starmie Super Mega Raid Day
timeline.detail: Mega Starmie debuts in Super Mega Raids with boosted shiny odds and up to 6 free Raid Passes from Gym spins; optional $4.99 ticket raises that to 14 plus Rare Candy XL.

timeline.title: Pokemon XP and 2026 Worlds
timeline.detail: Worlds-themed XP event runs Aug 25 at 10am to Aug 30 at 8pm local; full details not yet announced, check back before it starts.

weekly_rhythm: Spotlight Hour is Thursdays 6-7pm local this season; Raid Hour is Wednesdays 6-7pm local; Max Monday runs 6am-9pm local
Thu Jul 30: Spotlight Hour, Bidoof, 2x transfer Candy
Thu Aug 6: Spotlight Hour, Delibird, bonus not yet announced
Thu Aug 13: Spotlight Hour, Wurmple, bonus not yet announced
Thu Aug 20: Spotlight Hour, Magikarp, bonus not yet announced
Thu Aug 27: Spotlight Hour, Mankey, bonus not yet announced
Max Mondays: Jul 27 Feebas, Aug 3 Magmar, Aug 10 Beldum, Aug 17 Magikarp, Aug 24 Hitmontop (all Dynamax)
5-star raids: Solgaleo through Jul 28; Kyurem Jul 29 - Aug 4; Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf Aug 5-11; Groudon Aug 12-18; Lunala Aug 19-25; Regirock, Regice, and Registeel Aug 26 - Sep 8
Shadow Raids (weekends): Shadow Palkia through Aug 4, then Shadow Giratina (Altered) Aug 5 - Sep 8, shiny possible
Mega Raids: Salamence through Jul 28, Aggron Jul 29 - Aug 4, Blaziken Aug 5-11, Garchomp Aug 12-18, Swampert Aug 19-25, Gyarados Aug 26 - Sep 8

GO Battle League (flips Tuesdays 1pm PDT): Great League + Master Premier Jul 28 - Aug 4 (4x win Stardust), Ultra League + Weather Cup Aug 4-11, Master League + Evolution Cup Aug 11-18, Great League + Scroll Cup Aug 18-25, GL/UL/ML Aug 25 - Sep 1
Sun Jul 26, 10am-7pm local: GO Fest 2026 Sunday Raid Makeup
just_past_window: Mon Aug 31: Max Monday, Dynamax Eevee
Sep 5-6: GO Pass: August uncapped GO Points weekend
Sep 8, 10am local: Forever Forward season and GO Pass: August rank earning end
Sep 10, 10am local: GO Pass: August rewards expire, claim before then

games.typical_lead_time: in-game events announced only 4-7 days ahead; DLC and update news months ahead

timeline.title: Zorua's Hide-and-Sneak Contest
timeline.detail: Find Zorua at a rebuilt Pokemon Center and race hide-and-sneak courses for prizes including a trophy; ends Jul 27 at 4:59am local.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Chansey Plant
timeline.detail: Enter code P0K0P1AGARDENS at any Pokemon Center PC (Mystery Gift, Get with Code/Password) for a placeable Chansey Plant; international, valid through Oct 7.

timeline.title: Mystery Gift: Ditto Rug
timeline.detail: Claim the Ditto Rug at any Pokemon Center PC via the Get via Internet option, no code needed; international, available through Jan 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Expansion Pass
timeline.detail: The three-part Expansion Pass is on the eShop now and includes a dynamic Ditto print recipe plus a 30 rare Pokemetal ingots code if bought by Aug 31, 2027.

timeline.title: Free update: Dive
timeline.detail: A free August update lets all players learn Dive to explore, build, and plant on the ocean floor; requires the Bleak Beach environment request, jump, and Surf.
timeline.estimate_basis: Official sources confirm August 2026; no specific day announced

timeline.title: Expansion Pass Part 1: Bubbly Basin
timeline.detail: Part 1 adds an underwater town with new furniture, outfits, and sea Pokemon (Popplio, Mudkip, Corphish lines, Manaphy); requires Dive.
timeline.estimate_basis: Official sources confirm August 2026; no specific day announced

timeline.title: Bubbly Basin demo at Worlds
timeline.detail: Play a Bubbly Basin demo at the Nintendo booth during PokemonXP and the 2026 Pokemon World Championships in San Francisco.

just_past_window: Aug 29-30: PokemonXP and the 2026 Pokemon World Championships continue in San Francisco, Bubbly Basin demo playable at the Nintendo booth
